entities.summary: Leandro Despouy, who was born in San Luis, Argentina, was an Argentine human rights lawyer. He was the United Nations Commission on Human Rights Special Rapporteur on the Independence of Judges and Lawyers from August 2003 until end of July 2009. He was also Special Rapporteur of the Sub-Commission on Prevention of Discrimination and Protection of Minorities
